# iteathen — public repository index

> Canonical machine-readable discovery index for the public open-source repositories owned by `iteathen`.

An agent that starts from https://github.com/iteathen should use this file to discover repositories. Read-only access does not require a GitHub account, connector, token, or REST API.

## Discovery

- Human profile: https://github.com/iteathen
- This index: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/.github/main/llms.txt
- Public Pages mirror: https://iteathen.github.io/llms.txt
- Shared agent instructions: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/.github/main/AGENTS.md
- Shared security policy: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/.github/main/SECURITY.md
- Shared evidence policy: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/.github/main/EVIDENCE_POLICY.md

For a repository below, read its `llms.txt` first, then follow its repository-local `AGENTS.md` when present. Prefer anonymous Git, raw HTTPS, or codeload snapshots over the GitHub REST API.

## Generic anonymous access

For repository `<repo>`:

- Git: `https://github.com/iteathen/<repo>.git`
- Raw: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/<repo>/main/`
- ZIP: `https://codeload.github.com/iteathen/<repo>/zip/refs/heads/main`
- tar.gz: `https://codeload.github.com/iteathen/<repo>/tar.gz/refs/heads/main`

Repository-local authority takes precedence over this account index.
